rules.zh: 关联 API 密钥以使用 Antigravity Agent Preview

rules.zh: Antigravity Agent Preview 通过 API 密钥提供服务。关联密钥即可开始使用。

rules.en: Upgrade to unlock Gemini 3 Flash Preview
rules.zh: 升级以使用 Gemini 3 Flash Preview

rules.en: Gemini 3 Flash Preview is only available in the Playground via a Google AI Plan or an API key. Upgrade to unlock access to more models, features and higher limits across AI Studio.
rules.zh: 在模型实验室中使用 Gemini 3 Flash Preview 需要 Google AI 套餐或 API 密钥。升级可获得更多模型、功能和更高额度。

rules.en: This agent can execute code, take real actions, and use large number of tokens. You can stop the agent at any time.
rules.zh: 此智能体可以执行代码、采取实际操作，并可能消耗大量 Token。你可以随时停止智能体。

rules.en: Each execution spins up an isolated environment where your agent can run code and manage files.
rules.zh: 每次执行都会启动一个独立环境，供智能体运行代码和管理文件。

rules.en: Start typing a prompt to see what our agents can do
rules.zh: 输入提示词，体验智能体的能力

rules.en: Search for a model or agent

rules.zh: 选择 Antigravity 智能体使用的模型

rules.en: Pricing is based on the configured model.
rules.zh: 费用按配置的模型计算。

rules.en: This model uses Gemini 3.1 Pro and Gemini 3 Flash pricing. Developers may see both items on their bill.
rules.zh: 此模型采用 Gemini 3.1 Pro 和 Gemini 3 Flash 的价格，账单中可能同时出现这两项费用。

rules.en: A general-purpose autonomous agent running in a remote, Google-hosted Linux environment.
rules.zh: 在 Google 托管的远程 Linux 环境中运行的通用自主智能体。

rules.en: Our agent for long-running context gathering & synthesis tasks, optimized for speed and efficiency.
rules.zh: 适合长时间信息收集与综合任务的智能体，针对速度和效率优化。

rules.en: Our SOTA agent for long-running context gathering & synthesis tasks, optimized for maximum search exhaustiveness and report comprehensiveness.
rules.zh: 用于长时间信息收集与综合任务的前沿智能体，注重搜索充分性与报告完整性。

rules.en: Our most intelligent Flash model, engineered for long-horizon software engineering, autonomous agents, and complex enterprise workflows.
rules.zh: 智能程度最高的 Flash 模型，面向长期软件工程、自主智能体和复杂企业工作流。

rules.en: Our high-speed, efficient Flash model built for everyday coding, agentic tool use, and reliable multi-step execution.
rules.zh: 高速高效的 Flash 模型，适合日常编程、智能体工具调用与可靠的多步骤执行。

rules.en: Our fastest, most cost-effective 3.5 model for high-throughput execution.
rules.zh: 速度最快、性价比最高的 3.5 模型，适合高吞吐量执行。

rules.en: Our latest SOTA reasoning model with unprecedented depth and nuance, and powerful multimodal understanding and coding capabilities
rules.zh: 最新的前沿推理模型，具备深入细致的推理能力，以及强大的多模态理解和编程能力。

rules.en: Our previous generation Flash model, balancing speed and multimodal capabilities across general agentic and everyday tasks.
rules.zh: 上一代 Flash 模型，在通用智能体与日常任务中兼顾速度和多模态能力。

rules.en: Our earlier Flash model, built for speed and foundational performance across routine, high-throughput workloads.
rules.zh: 较早一代 Flash 模型，面向常规高吞吐量任务，注重速度和基础性能。

rules.en: A real-time speech-to-speech translation model delivering low latency translation for 70+ languages.
rules.zh: 实时语音到语音翻译模型，为 70 多种语言提供低延迟翻译。

rules.en: Our most cost-efficient model, optimized for high-volume agentic tasks, translation, and simple data processing.
rules.zh: 成本效率最高的模型，针对大批量智能体任务、翻译及简单数据处理优化。

rules.en: Our legacy Flash model, providing baseline speed and intelligence.
rules.zh: 较早的 Flash 模型，提供基础的速度和智能能力。

rules.en: Our smallest and most cost effective image generation and editing model, built for at scale usage.
rules.zh: 体积最小、成本最低的图片生成与编辑模型，面向大规模使用。

rules.en: Pro-level visual intelligence with Flash-speed efficiency and reality-grounded generation capabilities.
rules.zh: 兼具 Pro 级视觉智能、Flash 级效率与基于真实世界信息的生成能力。

rules.en: State-of-the-art image generation and editing model.
rules.zh: 前沿图片生成与编辑模型。

rules.en: Our specialized, high-accuracy speech-to-text model optimized for processing pre-recorded files and static payloads. Engineered to deliver deep, structured transcripts with rich archival metadata.
rules.zh: 高精度语音转文字专用模型，针对预录文件和静态数据优化，可生成包含丰富归档元数据的结构化转录。

rules.en: Our state-of-the-art image generation and editing model.
rules.zh: 前沿图片生成与编辑模型。

rules.en: An alias to our latest Pro model which changes over time.
rules.zh: 始终指向最新 Pro 模型的别名，具体模型会随时间更新。

rules.en: An alias to our latest Flash model which changes over time.
rules.zh: 始终指向最新 Flash 模型的别名，具体模型会随时间更新。

rules.en: An alias to our latest Flash-Lite model which changes over time.
rules.zh: 始终指向最新 Flash-Lite 模型的别名，具体模型会随时间更新。

rules.en: Embodied reasoning model delivering advanced video understanding, spatial reasoning, multi-step tool orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration for robotics tasks.
rules.zh: 具身推理模型，为机器人任务提供高级视频理解、空间推理、多步骤工具编排与多机器人协作。

rules.en: Our low-latency, real-time dialogue model optimized for fluid, uninterrupted conversations with seamless, background async function calling.
rules.zh: 低延迟实时对话模型，支持流畅不中断的对话，以及后台无缝异步函数调用。

rules.en: Our high-precision audio model engineered for complex tasks, capable of in-depth reasoning while speaking with natural verbal cues.
rules.zh: 面向复杂任务的高精度音频模型，可在深入推理的同时，通过自然语气进行表达。

rules.en: Our low-latency, audio-to-audio model optimized for real-time dialogue with acoustic nuance detection, numeric precision, and multimodal awareness.
rules.zh: 面向实时对话优化的低延迟语音到语音模型，支持声学细节检测、精确数字处理与多模态理解。

rules.en: Our ultra-low latency, real-time streaming speech-to-text model. Engineered to transcribe live audio inputs on-the-fly with rapid-fire textual updates.
rules.zh: 超低延迟实时流式语音转文字模型，可实时转录音频输入并快速更新文字。

rules.en: Embodied reasoning model optimized for real-time text streaming. Delivers advanced video understanding, spatial reasoning, multi-step tool orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration at faster speeds.
rules.zh: 针对实时文本流优化的具身推理模型，以更快速度提供高级视频理解、空间推理、多步骤工具编排与多机器人协作。

rules.en: Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS: Powerful, low-latency speech generation. Enjoy natural outputs, steerable prompts, and new expressive audio tags for precise narration control.
rules.zh: Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS：强大的低延迟语音生成，支持自然输出、可控提示词及富有表现力的音频标签，便于精确控制旁白。

rules.en: Our advanced, full-song generative model with enhanced audio fidelity and vocal clarity, optimized for precise prompt adherence and rich, cohesive musical arrangements.
rules.zh: 先进的完整歌曲生成模型，提升音频保真度与人声清晰度，注重准确遵循提示词和丰富连贯的音乐编排。

rules.en: Our advanced, full-song generative model with deep compositional understanding, optimized for precise structural control and complex transitions across diverse musical styles.
rules.zh: 具备深入作曲理解的完整歌曲生成模型，支持精确结构控制及多种音乐风格间的复杂过渡。

rules.en: Our low-latency, music generation model optimized for high-fidelity audio clips and precise rhythmic control.
rules.zh: 低延迟音乐生成模型，针对高保真音频片段与精确节奏控制优化。

rules.en: Our 2.5 Pro text-to-speech audio model optimized for powerful, low-latency speech generation for more natural outputs and easier to steer prompts.
rules.zh: 2.5 Pro 文本转语音模型，提供强大的低延迟语音生成，输出更自然、提示词更易控制。

rules.en: Our 2.5 Flash text-to-speech audio model optimized for price-performant, low-latency, controllable speech generation.
rules.zh: 2.5 Flash 文本转语音模型，兼顾性价比、低延迟和生成可控性。

rules.en: Production-ready generative video with keyframe control and scene extension. Bring text, image, and video references to life, seamlessly extend scenes up to 30 seconds, and upscale outputs up to 4K.
rules.zh: 可用于生产的视频生成模型，支持关键帧控制与场景延展。可使用文字、图片和视频作为参考，将场景无缝延长至 30 秒，并将输出提升至最高 4K。

rules.en: Gemini Omni Flash: Powerful video generation and conversational editing. Bring text and images to life as stunning video, and effortlessly refine your outputs through simple natural language.
rules.zh: Gemini Omni Flash：强大的视频生成与对话式编辑，可将文字和图片转为视频，并通过自然语言轻松调整结果。

rules.en: Our latest video generation model, available to developers on the paid tier of the Gemini API.
rules.zh: 最新的视频生成模型，面向 Gemini API 付费层级的开发者开放。

rules.en: A faster, more accessible version of Veo 3.1, optimized for speed and business use cases. Available to developers on the paid tier of the Gemini API.
rules.zh: 更快、更易使用的 Veo 3.1 版本，针对速度和商业场景优化，面向 Gemini API 付费层级的开发者开放。

rules.en: Our most cost-efficient video generation model, designed for rapid iteration and building high-volume applications.
rules.zh: 成本效率最高的视频生成模型，适合快速迭代和大批量应用。

rules.en: A Mixture-of-Experts model that activates only 4B parameters per inference, delivering high-performance reasoning with a fraction of the memory cost — ideal for cost-efficient, high-throughput server deployments.
rules.zh: 混合专家模型，每次推理仅激活 4B 参数，以较低内存开销提供高性能推理，适合高性价比、高吞吐量的服务器部署。

rules.en: Google DeepMind's flagship open-weight dense model, purpose-built for maximum quality in data center environments with a 256K context window and advanced long-context architecture.
